label: rem:prolongation-categorical
title: Prolongation from the Frobenius--Hopf structure
html:
Jet prolongation emerges as an intrinsic consequence of the Frobenius–Hopf structure within a rigid monoidal category. It requires no geometric input beyond the categorical data (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau). Concretely:

  1. The Frobenius structure supplies the Kähler differentials \Omega^1(A) as a direct summand, defining the jet object J^1(A).
  2. The Frobenius relation enforces compatibility between comultiplication and multiplication, ensuring the prolonged object inherits the full Hopf algebra structure.
  3. Non-degeneracy and vanishing conditions propagate from A to J^1(A) through functoriality.

Iterating this categorical jet construction generates the recursive brane tower. The tower and its associated descent (Subsection) follow from the QOU axioms without case-by-case verification.
